figurative_meaning_en: in rows or queues, in countless numbers
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাস স্ট্যান্ডে কাতারে কাতারে যাত্রীদের ভিড়।
example_sentences_in_english: People arrived at the fair in queues one after another.
There was a crowd of passengers queuing up line after line at the bus stand.
note: This idiom reflects common experiences with queues in daily life, such as markets or public transport in Bengali-speaking regions.
